title.narrative: Kenya boosted child protection financing through UNICEF's advocacy and technical support. For the Directorate of Children Services, emergency allocations rose by 400%, and operational budgets by 6% (2024/25 to 2025/26). These gains, achieved despite fiscal constraints, reflect strengthened systems, evidence-based planning, and high-level policy engagement under the Bogota pledge.
